AI Video Editor Mobile — 1.0.0

- Initial release: AI-powered mobile video editing tool for fast, automated social media exports.
- Upload phone footage (MP4, MOV, 3GP, WebM up to 500MB) for instant editing without desktop software.
- Describe desired edits—trim, transitions, aspect ratio, overlays, export for TikTok/Reels—and get results in ~30–60 seconds.
- Cloud GPU pipeline handles all rendering and compression; supports vertical 9:16 video, 1080p MP4, and more.
- No credits required for exports on free plan; easy anonymous sign-in with auto token management.
- Error codes, file validation, and status updates included for a smooth user experience.
